## Rails 7.2.1 ##

*   Fix Inflectors when locale fallbacks to `:en`.

*   Make `delegate` and `delegate_missing_to` work in BasicObject subclasses.

*   Fix `ActiveSupport::TimeWithZone#as_json` to return UTF-8 strings.


## Rails 7.2.0 ##

*   Remove deprecated `Benchmark.ms` method.

*   Remove deprecated passing a Time object to `Time#since`.
